name: mindferry
description: Auto-connects Claude Code to your MindFerry context hub: reads relevant notes at session start, saves a summary back when a session ends.

hub_url.title: MindFerry hub URL
hub_url.description: Your MindFerry deployment's public origin, e.g. https://mindferry.example.com

api_key.title: Agent API key
api_key.description: From Settings -> API Keys -> Agent API Keys in your MindFerry deployment. Needs REMOTE_AGENTS role permission.
